note: Both sets correctly capture the grade level (0' - 0") and finished floor (2' - 9 1/2") datums for the West and East Module sections, and both bind the finished-floor height to the modules relative to grade. Set B additionally captures the drawing scale (3/8" = 1'-0") for both sections, an important fact Set A omits entirely. Set A's claims are all supported but redundant, including one generic grade-level claim with no section condition. Set B's only real defect is the vague 'building | grade level' claim, which misbinds a datum to the building entity.
